Major AI Developments.title: JSFDA conclave focuses on modernizing teaching methods; Calls for integration of technology and AI in classrooms
Major AI Developments.summary: Jharkhand's Faculty Development Academy held its inaugural conclave, emphasizing the need to modernize teaching methods by integrating technology and AI in classrooms. The event focused on equipping students to become nation-builders and promoting entrepreneurship using state resources. The conclave aimed to achieve the transformative goals of the National Education Policy 2020.

Major AI Developments.title: Jharkhand rural dept pioneers AI training programme; Aiming for improved efficiency and transparency in project execution
Major AI Developments.summary: Jharkhand's rural development department is adopting artificial intelligence to improve efficiency and transparency in project execution. The department has launched an AI Support Cell and is providing extensive training programs for its employees. This initiative aims to enable employees to utilize AI tools for efficient document handling and data analysis.

Major AI Developments.title: Campus Diary
Major AI Developments.summary: NUSRL, Ranchi, has partnered with Cyber Peace to collaborate on cyber law, AI governance, and security. Jharkhand Raksha Shakti University launched a disaster risk reduction club and Ranchi University set up a health and wellness centre. BIT students also developed an all-terrain vehicle for a national competition, showcasing their innovative skills.

Major AI Developments.title: Jharkhand Boosts Technical Education with AI & Emerging Tech Centres of Excellence
Major AI Developments.summary: Jharkhand's higher and technical education department is setting up Centres of Excellence at BIT Sindri and GEC Palamu to enhance technical education. The centres will focus on AI and emerging technologies, providing students with industry-aligned learning opportunities and hands-on experience. This initiative aims to improve employability and placement outcomes for students.
